newsitem.title: USA: Chico's FAS Sept same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Chico's FAS Sept same-store sales fall.

text.p: Chico's FAS Inc said Thursday total sales for September increased 9.6 percent to $6.1 million from $5.6 million reported for the same period a year ago.
Comparable store sales for the company-owned stores decreased 0.5 percent for the five week period.

Total sales for the quarter ended September 29, 1996, increased 2.4 percent to $15.7 million from $15.3 million for the same quarter a year ago. Comparable store sales for the company-owned stores decreased 1.3 percent for the thirteen week period.

For the thirty-nine week period ended September 29, 1996, total sales increased 5.7 percent to $48.1 million from $45.5 million for the same period in 1995. Comparable store sales for the company-owned stores increased 2.0 percent for the thirty-nine week period.
